visual.general_description: Infographic with four colored boxes of initial values, a Mazdutide bottle with a 2 mg to 4 mg to 6 mg label, an arrow and a green box of results.
visual.detailed_description: Left: four rounded colored boxes titled "Overweight" (BMI 30.64 kg/m²), "MASLD with Hyperlipidemia" (TC 6.08 mmol/L, TG 1.84 mmol/L), "Diabetes" (Fasting blood glucose 9.34 mmol/L, HbA1c 9.60%) and "Hyperuricemia" (Serum uric acid 511 µmol/L), with a black human silhouette labelled "15-year-old" at the centre of the group. A large plus sign leads to a teal bottle labelled "Mazdutide" with "2 mg →4 mg →6 mg" beneath; a dark arrow points right to a green box beside a black running silhouette. The green box lists four bullets: weight reduction (BMI reduced to 24.86 kg/m², 18.89% down arrow), lowering serum uric acid (322 µmol/L, 37.00%), glycemic control (fasting blood glucose 8.75 mmol/L, HbA1c 7.5%, 21.88%) and resolution of MASLD and lipid-lowering (TC 5.25 mmol/L, 13.65%; TG 0.57 mmol/L, 69.02%). Values are printed in red.
